name: Sea of Cinders
summary: Ash and embers sweep the Sea of Cinders, north of Blackrock Mountain.

sections.title: A Wasteland of Embers
sections.body: Ash and burning grit sweep the plain between the Searing Gorge cliffs and Blackrock Mountain. Centuries ago, the Firelord Ragnaros was summoned into the mortal world. The upheaval fractured the Redridge Mountains and left the surrounding land an arid slag heap. The Sea of Cinders is one of the cataclysm’s most barren remnants, where the earth never cools.

sections.title: Peril Beneath the Slopes
sections.body: Travelers and scavengers taking the north approach to Blackrock Mountain often cross these scorching flats. Winds drive blinding ash clouds across the way, hiding sudden fissures, elemental horrors, and predators adapted to the heat. Dark Iron dwarves claim this hostile land. Anyone crossing the cinders must stay watchful and move swiftly.

faq.q: What is the Sea of Cinders?
faq.answer: The Sea of Cinders lies in southern Searing Gorge, against the northern face of Blackrock Mountain. Smoldering dirt and flying embers blanket this desolate flatland.

faq.q: Why is the ground constantly burning?
faq.answer: Centuries ago, Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan summoned the Firelord Ragnaros during the War of the Three Hammers. The eruption superheated the earth and shattered the mountains, and the plains still smolder.

No organized settlement stands within the Sea of Cinders. Heat, poor air, and lack of water make permanent habitation impossible, though wandering beasts, fire elementals, and patrols affiliated with Blackrock Mountain cross the expanse.

faq.q: What makes traveling through here dangerous?
faq.answer: Hostile beasts and Dark Iron dwarves threaten travelers near the mountain. Blinding soot and burning ash fill the air, while deep thermal rifts split the flat terrain.

angles.text: Heat-cracked stone near Blackrock Mountain can expose rich mineral deposits and dark iron veins to those who brave the drifting ash.
As a Bronzebeard or Wildhammer dwarf, you walk through wastes that recall Thaurissan's folly and the dark powers that shattered the Redridge Mountains.
